Name: The Walking Dead Telltale Series Hats
Author: cauganly
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]This mod adds Clementine, Kenny, and Nick's caps from The Walking Dead game to Stardew Valley. There are 17 hats in total, including other colors.[color=#d9d2e9] [i]The mod is compatible with the latest version of Stardew Valley.[/i][/color][/size][/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#b4a7d6][size=4]Clementine caps:[/size][/color][/font][font=Comic Sans MS]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]•[/size][/color][size=3] Original blue[/size]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]•[/size][/color][size=3] Dark purple[/size]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]•[/size][/color][size=3] Black[/size]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]•[/size][/color][size=3] White[/size]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]•[/size][/color][size=3] Blue and red[/size]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]•[/size][/color][size=3] Red[/size]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]•[/size][/color][size=3] Can be dyed any color[/size]

[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]Kenny caps:[/size][/color]
[/font]•[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] Original orange
[/size][/font]•[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] Black
[/size][/font]•[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] White
[/size][/font]•[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] Blue and red
[/size][/font]•[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] Can be dyed any color[/size]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]
[/size][size=4]Nick caps:[/size][/color]
[/font]•[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] Original burgundy[/size]
[/font]•[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] Black[/size]
[/font]•[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] White[/size]
[/font]•[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] Blue and red[/size]
[/font]•[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] Can be dyed any color[/size]

[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]Gabe hats:[/size][/color]
[/font]•[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] Original orange[/size]
[/font]•[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] Black[/size]
[/font]•[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] White[/size]
[/font]•[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] Can be dyed any color[/size]

[color=#b4a7d6][size=5]Installation:[/size][/color]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]1.[/size][/color][size=3] Install Fashion Sense, SMAPI, and my mod.[/size]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]2.[/size][/color][size=3] [/size][size=3]Unpack the archives.[/size]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]3.[/size][/color][size=3] Move the unpacked folders to the Mods folder.[/size]

[i][color=#d9d2e9]To put on a hat, you need to buy a hand mirror from Pierre for 1,500 gold, click on the mirror with the left mouse button, and then on your character. Select the hat category and choose the one you like.[/color][/i]

[size=3]If you have any problems with the mod or would like to suggest adding someone's headgear or accessories, please write to me and I will help or add them![/size][i]
[/i]

[size=5][color=#b4a7d6]Установка:[/color]

[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]2.[/size][/color][size=3] Распаковать архивы.[/size]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]3.[/size][/color][color=#f4cccc] [/color][color=#f4f4f4]Переместить распакованные папки в папку Mods.

[/color][i][size=3][color=#d9d2e9]Чтобы надеть головной убор, нужно купить ручное зеркало у Пьера за 1500 золотых, кликнуть на зеркало левой кнопкой мыши, а затем на вашего персонажа. Выбрать категорию шляп и выбрать понравившееся вам.[/color]

[/size][/i][size=3]Если у вас возникли проблемы с модом или вы хотите предложить добавить чей-то головной убор или аксессуары, то пишите, [/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]я [/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]помогу или добавлю![/size][/font]
